# apple_game_center_leaderboard_sets (Data Source)

Lists the Game Center leaderboard sets of an app or of a group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_game_center_leaderboard_sets" "app" {
  game_center_detail_id = data.apple_game_center_detail.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `game_center_detail_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of an app's Game Center detail. Set this or `game_center_group_id`.
- `game_center_group_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of a Game Center group. Set this or `game_center_detail_id`.

### Read-Only

- `leaderboard_sets` (Attributes List) The leaderboard sets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--leaderboard_sets))

<a id="nestedatt--leaderboard_sets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `leaderboard_sets`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the leaderboard set.
- `reference_name` (String) Name of the set in App Store Connect.
- `vendor_identifier` (String) Identifier of the set.
